item.title: Women’s health market booms – but gaps persist
item.description: As International Women’s Day approaches, data on the global women’s health market paints a mixed picture. The post Women’s health market booms – but gaps persist appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Children’s Literacy Stunted During COVID-19-Induced Remote Learning
item.description: Children experienced losses equivalent to 3 months of skill development in literacy and 14 months of growth in numeracy during the COVID-19 pandemic. The post Children’s Literacy Stunted During COVID-19-Induced Remote Learning appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Can Exercise Prevent Cancer-Related Lymphedema?
item.description: Exercise was associated with reduced cancer-related lymphedema risk, with meta-analysis showing a 29.0% relative reduction overall. The post Can Exercise Prevent Cancer-Related Lymphedema? appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Gut Microbiome Remodelling Reduces Neuroinflammation in TBI
item.description: Antibiotic-treated mice demonstrated significantly smaller lesion volumes and reduced cell death compared with vehicle-treated controls after repeated injury. The post Gut Microbiome Remodelling Reduces Neuroinflammation in TBI appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: GLP-1RAs Could Help People Quit Smoking
item.description: Nicotine-seeking behaviours and activity in the brain’s reward pathway have been found to be dampened through the activation of glucose-like peptide-1 receptors. The post GLP-1RAs Could Help People Quit Smoking appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Obesity Hypoventilation Syndrome Treatment Improves Sleep
item.description: Obesity hypoventilation syndrome treatment improved as acetazolamide with atomoxetine reduced mean CO2 and AHI, raising saturation. The post Obesity Hypoventilation Syndrome Treatment Improves Sleep appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: ECR 2026: MRI Reveals Glucometabolic Dysregulation in CSVD
item.description: New imaging research links glucose dysregulation with progression of cerebral small vessel disease, suggesting metabolic biomarkers may help identify patients at risk of worsening brain damage. The post ECR 2026: MRI Reveals Glucometabolic Dysregulation in CSVD appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Pompe Disease: New Tools for Earlier Care
item.description: Pompe disease management is evolving as next-generation enzyme replacement, gene therapy, and digital monitoring reshape decisions. The post Pompe Disease: New Tools for Earlier Care appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: ECR 2026: Age and Smoking Trends Vary in Lung Cancer Screening Cohort
item.description: Age and smoking status influence CT-based body composition in lung cancer screening, with muscle loss and fat gain increasing with age in a large NELSON cohort analysis. The post ECR 2026: Age and Smoking Trends Vary in Lung Cancer Screening Cohort appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: ISGE 2026: Breast Cancer Risk Screening Before HRT
item.description: Researchers report that biomarkers such as PGRMC1 and oestrogen metabolism ratios may improve breast cancer risk screening before hormone replacement therapy, supporting more personalised clinical decisions. The post ISGE 2026: Breast Cancer Risk Screening Before HRT appeared first on European Medical Journal.
